class.name: SemanticAsyncSearchWorker
class.brief_description: Background worker that runs semantic asset searches off the main thread.
class.description: Queues asynchronous semantic search jobs through the active [SemanticSearchBackend]. Poll jobs with [method poll_search] until they finish or are cancelled.

method.name: cancel_search
method.description: Requests cancellation of the search job identified by [param job_id]. Returns [code]true[/code] when the job existed.

method.name: enqueue_search
method.description: Starts a background search for [param query] and returns a job id, or an empty string if the job could not be queued.

method.name: poll_search
method.description: Returns status for [param job_id], including [code]ok[/code], [code]finished[/code], and [code]results[/code] when complete.
